newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA BAT AGAINST WESTERN PROVINCE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA BAT AGAINST WESTERN PROVINCE.

text.p: Australian captain Mark Taylor won the toss and elected to bat first on the first day of Australia's three day match against Western Province at Newlands on Saturday.
Western Province - Sven Koenig, Gary Kirsten, Jacques Kallis, Herschelle Gibbs, HD Ackerman, John Commins (captain), Brian McMillan, Mario Solomons, Craig Matthews, Meyrick Pringle, Brett Schultz,
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Hayden, Matthew Elliot, Justin Langer, Greg Blewitt, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Andrew Bichel, Paul Reiffel, Jason Gillespie.
